verdict.rationale: Supabase documents a Management API for creating and managing organizations and projects programmatically. It also documents branching, which gives isolated preview environments per pull request, so per-preview isolated databases and programmatic fleet control are covered. Nothing in the evidence shows that creating thousands of projects is cheap or supported at that scale, or that per-agent or per-tenant database provisioning is a supported pattern. missing for 10: evidence of low cost per database, evidence of scale to thousands of instances, documented per-agent/per-tenant database provisioning, hands-on corroboration of fleet management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can cheaply create thousands of isolated databases — one per agent, tenant, or preview — and manage the fleet programmatically

citations.quote: Manage your Supabase organizations and projects programmatically.
Branching takes this further, adding isolated preview environments for each pull request.
Supabase branches create separate environments that spin off from your main project.
